card.name: Words right before success or working
card.fires_on: A word that refers back to an attempt, plan or effort (such as it, they, program, effort, working) just where the text goes on to say whether it succeeded or worked.

modes.label: Verb of working
modes.description: The word 'working' or 'worked' judging whether a measure had its intended effect.
modes.example: So far, it seems to be<< working>>. There are no reports of hydrilla

modes.label: Pronoun or noun for an attempt
modes.description: A pronoun or noun standing for a plan or effort, right before a success or result statement.
modes.example: They<< were>> successful, and Samuel donated $10

card.writes: It promotes words about effectiveness and success, in English and Chinese.
card.plain: It marks the spot where the text is about to say whether an attempt worked.
